challenge.better_approach: Considered having the tester write a proofs/*.py stub declaring PROVES for the host-seam ticket so declaring() finds it; rejected: the proof would be a fake wrapper around the verify, and its seal would not carry the box-local host facts, so a drifted host would read green. Naming the intention lets standing() do the box-local check dfe6 already built.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That the other PROVED gates (proof_named, verdict, the inspector run) admit an intention json as a named proof. proof_named only resolves the name to a file, which the intention is; the verdict is the orchestrator's chart answer. The build measures each by running the fixture crossing.
challenge.prior_art: Consulted CairnCommons/tickets for host-seam + clearance/proven_by: only dfe6c1432fc8 (built the seal, kept clearance out of bounds). grep for host_seam in clearance/ and proof_coverage/ returns nothing.
challenge.real_collision: clearance's docstring forbids handing the caller its own proven_by (record vs crossing); this keeps that: the gate derives the name from the ticket's owning_intention, not from the caller. A distinction to record, not a collision.

answers.falsifier: A no-target cross of a fixture host-seam ticket is refused 'names no proof' at HEAD; after the build it is refused before a seal, clears after cli --host-seam --seal on this box, and refuses again after a host fact moves.
answers.from_idea: none, because it is dfe6c1432fc8's measured follow-up: the orchestrator found 2026-11-13 that a no-target cross of a host-seam ticket hands clearance an empty proven_by (cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance/gate.py declaring() finds no proofs/*.py PROVES for 496dcbeba174 or b1f182b6b818), recorded on ticket CairnCommons/tickets/dfe6c1432fc8-the-tester-seals-a-host-seam-s-verify-on-this-box.json
answers.how: gate.py proven_by: for a ticket whose node_class is host-seam, name its owning_intention (resolved under the commons). clearance.py rule 2 already calls standing(), which dispatches host-seam since dfe6; rule 2b at PROVED takes a proven host-seam standing as the coverage for that entry instead of PROVES teeth and hollow, which a command over the host does not have. Red-first proof over a fixture host-seam ticket in a scratch crossing world.
answers.traces_to: Law 8 — nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build couldn't pass; for a host-seam the proof is the box-local verify seal (node_classes/host-seam.json prove_gate).
answers.what: A host-seam ticket's crossing through the clearance gate names its owning intention as the proof, and clearance judges that proof by this box's host-seam standing(), so a sealed verify on this box clears the crossing and an unsealed or drifted one refuses.
